label: Whole-power and strict purity constrain the perfection-of-being vocabulary
paraphrase: Closed conditional consequence on one primitive OwnBeing witness n: whole-power possession, pure-perfections-pertain-to-being, own-being-is-no-recipient and nonrecipient-determinations-are-pure imply OfBeing d iff Pure d for every determination d. All four interfaces and OwnBeing n are explicit internal hypotheses. A second conjunct proves that the positive whole-power clause is preserved by extension of Has; it does not by itself exclude added determinations. These are an extensional scope cost and a positive-clause stability test, not a definition of either classification, a claim that an OwnBeing witness exists, a new no-defect clause, or a refutation of an actual source proposal. It concerns determinations, not a claim that all beings are pure.
